title: Fix micromamba initialization in Codespaces setup
body:
####Description

This PR fixes the GitHub Codespaces initialization issue described in #34964.
The issue caused a newly created scikit-learn Codespace to enter recovery mode instead of starting the intended development environment.

#### Reference Issues/PRs
Fixes #34964

#### What does this implement/fix? Explain your changes.
This fix rectifies the issue of codespace initialization due to issue in the setup.sh file under .devcontainer where i updated "micromamba activate sklearn-dev" with "micromamba run -n sklearn-dev pre-commit install" to correctly initialize the development environment. Also one more line is added "line 9" which is explicitly added just to forces the shell type explicitly instead of relying on auto-detection.

#### Introduce yourself
I am very new to the sklearn library and currently exploring it's use cases.
with this i would like to say that the thing that what encouraged me for creating this PR has an interesting story behind this, Actually to learn new things about open source contribution i started exploring github but due to hardware restriction i was unable to run all these thing in my machine so i used codespace for using the capabilities offered by github. There i selected SKlearn as my first repo and i identified this issue #34964 and finally after a thorough evaluation now i can surely say its right time to close this issue as according to me it is now rectified.

#### Testing

- Created a fresh GitHub Codespace from the updated branch "adityaakc".
- Verified that the Codespace starts in normal mode instead of recovery mode.
- Verified that the development environment initializes successfully without entering in "Recovery mode".


#### AI usage disclosure
I used AI assistance for:
- Code generation (e.g., when writing an implementation or fixing a bug)
- Research and understanding
